400.description: Invalid argument - The client specified an invalid argument

401.description: Unauthenticated - The request does not have valid authentication credentials

403.description: Permission denied - The caller does not have permission to execute the specified operation

404.description: Not found - Some requested entity was not found

408.description: Deadline exceeded - The deadline expired before the operation could complete

409.description: Aborted - The operation was aborted due to concurrency issue

412.description: Failed precondition - Operation was rejected because the system is not in required state

413.description: Out of range - Operation was attempted past the valid range

429.description: Resource exhausted - Some resource has been exhausted (rate limiting)

431.description: Request header fields too large - Request metadata was too large

499.description: Cancelled - The operation was cancelled by the client

501.description: Unimplemented - The operation is not implemented or supported

503.description: Unavailable - The service is currently unavailable

504.description: Deadline exceeded - Upstream service did not respond in time

BetaManagedAgentsUserMessageEvent.description: A user message event in the session conversation.

content.description: Array of content blocks comprising the user message.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when the agent finished processing this message.

BetaManagedAgentsUserInterruptEvent.description: An interrupt event that pauses agent execution and returns control to the user.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when the interrupt was processed.

session_thread_id.description: If absent, interrupts every non-archived thread in a multiagent session (or the primary alone in a single-agent session). If present, interrupts only the named thread.

BetaManagedAgentsUserToolConfirmationEve.description: A tool confirmation event that approves or denies a pending tool execution.

deny_message.description: Optional message providing context for a 'deny' decision. Only allowed when result is 'deny'.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when the confirmation was processed.

session_thread_id.description: Set by the server to the subagent thread this confirmation was routed to. Omitted when it was routed to the primary thread.

tool_use_id.description: The id of the `agent.tool_use` or `agent.mcp_tool_use` event this result corresponds to, which can be found in the last `session.status_idle` [event's](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/sessions/events/list#beta_managed_agents_session_requires_action.event_ids) `stop_reason.event_ids` field.

BetaManagedAgentsUserCustomToolResultEve.description: Event sent by the client providing the result of a custom tool execution.

content.description: The result content returned by the tool.

custom_tool_use_id.description: The id of the `agent.custom_tool_use` event this result corresponds to. It is also listed in the last `session.status_idle` [event's](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/sessions/events/list#beta_managed_agents_session_requires_action.event_ids) `stop_reason.event_ids` field.

is_error.description: Whether the tool execution resulted in an error.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when this result was processed.

session_thread_id.description: Set by the server to the subagent thread this result was routed to. Omitted when it was routed to the primary thread.

BetaManagedAgentsAgentCustomToolUseEvent.description: Event emitted when the agent calls a custom tool. The session goes idle until the client sends a `user.custom_tool_result` event with the result. The client can send it as soon as this event arrives, without waiting for `session.status_idle`.

input.description: Input parameters for the tool call.

name.description: Name of the custom tool being called.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when this tool use was processed.

session_thread_id.description: When set, this event was cross-posted from a subagent's thread to surface its custom tool use on the primary thread's stream. Empty on the thread's own events. Informational only: the server routes the matching `user.custom_tool_result` by `custom_tool_use_id`, so clients do not send it back.

BetaManagedAgentsAgentMessageEvent.description: An agent response event in the session conversation.

content.text: Let me look up order #1234 for you.

content.description: Array of text blocks comprising the agent response.

examples.text: Let me look up order #1234 for you.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when this response was generated.

BetaManagedAgentsAgentThinkingEvent.description: Indicates the agent is making forward progress via extended thinking. A progress signal, not a content carrier.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when this thinking was produced.

BetaManagedAgentsAgentMcpToolUseEvent.description: Event emitted when the agent invokes a tool provided by an MCP server.

evaluated_permission.description: The evaluated permission policy for this tool invocation.

evaluation.description: Which resolved permission_policy produced evaluated_permission: always_allow, always_ask, or auto (with the server's per-invocation judgement). Absent only when the server refused the call before any policy applied (for example, the named tool is not enabled in the session); such a refusal has evaluated_permission deny. An event recorded before this field existed reads as the arm its evaluated_permission implies (always_allow for allow, always_ask for ask).

input.description: Input parameters for the tool call.

mcp_server_name.description: Name of the MCP server providing the tool.

name.description: Name of the MCP tool being used.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when this event was processed.

session_thread_id.description: When set, this event was cross-posted from a subagent's thread to surface its permission request on the primary thread's stream. Empty on the thread's own events. Informational only: the server routes the matching `user.tool_confirmation` by `tool_use_id`, so clients do not send it back.

BetaManagedAgentsAgentMcpToolResultEvent.description: Event representing the result of an MCP tool execution.

content.description: The result content returned by the tool.

is_error.description: Whether the tool execution resulted in an error.

mcp_tool_use_id.description: The id of the `agent.mcp_tool_use` event this result corresponds to.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when this event was processed.

BetaManagedAgentsAgentToolUseEvent.description: Event emitted when the agent invokes a built-in agent tool.

evaluated_permission.description: The evaluated permission policy for this tool invocation.

evaluation.description: Which resolved permission_policy produced evaluated_permission: always_allow, always_ask, or auto (with the server's per-invocation judgement). Absent only when the server refused the call before any policy applied (for example, the named tool is not enabled in the session); such a refusal has evaluated_permission deny. An event recorded before this field existed reads as the arm its evaluated_permission implies (always_allow for allow, always_ask for ask).

input.description: Input parameters for the tool call.

name.description: Name of the agent tool being used.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when this event was processed.

session_thread_id.description: When set, this event was cross-posted from a subagent's thread to surface its permission request on the primary thread's stream. Empty on the thread's own events. Informational only: the server routes the matching `user.tool_confirmation` or `user.tool_result` by `tool_use_id`, so clients do not send it back.

BetaManagedAgentsAgentToolResultEvent.description: Event representing the result of an agent tool execution.

content.description: The result content returned by the tool.

is_error.description: Whether the tool execution resulted in an error.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when this event was processed.

tool_use_id.description: The id of the `agent.tool_use` event this result corresponds to.

BetaManagedAgentsAgentThreadMessageRecei.description: Delivery event written to the target thread's input stream when an agent-to-agent message arrives.

from_agent_name.description: Name of the callable agent this message came from. Absent when received from the primary agent.

from_session_thread_id.description: Public `sthr_` ID of the thread that sent the message.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when the message was received.

BetaManagedAgentsAgentThreadMessageSentE.description: Observability event emitted to the sender's output stream when an agent-to-agent message is sent.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when the message was sent.

to_agent_name.description: Name of the callable agent this message was sent to. Absent when sent to the primary agent.

to_session_thread_id.description: Public `sthr_` ID of the thread the message was sent to.

BetaManagedAgentsAgentThreadContextCompa.description: Indicates that context compaction (summarization) occurred during the session.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when compaction was processed.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionErrorEvent.description: An error event indicating a problem occurred during session execution.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when the error occurred.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionStatusReschedule.description: Indicates the session is recovering from an error state and is rescheduled for execution.

processed_at.description: Timestamp of status change.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionStatusRunningEve.description: Indicates the session is actively running and the agent is working.

processed_at.description: Timestamp of status change.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionStatusIdleEvent.description: Indicates the agent has paused and is awaiting user input.

processed_at.description: Timestamp of status change.

stop_details.description: Structured information about why the session stopped. `null` when there is nothing more to report.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionStatusTerminated.description: Indicates the session has terminated, either due to an error or completion.

processed_at.description: Timestamp of status change.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadCreatedEve.description: Emitted when a child thread is created. Written to the parent thread's output stream so clients observing the session see child creation.

agent_name.description: Name of the callable agent the thread runs.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when the thread was created.

session_thread_id.description: Public `sthr_` ID of the newly created thread.

workflow_run_id.description: Identifier of the workflow run that created the thread, or `null` for any other thread.

BetaManagedAgentsSpanOutcomeEvaluationSt.description: Emitted when an outcome evaluation cycle begins.

iteration.description: 0-indexed revision cycle. 0 is the first evaluation; 1 is the re-evaluation after the first revision; etc.

outcome_id.description: The `outc_` ID of the outcome being evaluated.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when outcome evaluation started.

BetaManagedAgentsSpanOutcomeEvaluationEn.description: Emitted when an outcome evaluation cycle completes. Carries the verdict and aggregate token usage. A verdict of `needs_revision` means another evaluation cycle follows; `satisfied`, `max_iterations_reached`, `failed`, or `interrupted` are terminal — no further evaluation cycles follow.

example.explanation: All five sections present with inline citations.

explanation.description: Human-readable explanation of the verdict. For `needs_revision`, describes which criteria failed and why.
examples: All five sections present with inline citations.

outcome_evaluation_start_id.description: The id of the corresponding `span.outcome_evaluation_start` event.

outcome_id.description: The `outc_` ID of the outcome being evaluated.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when outcome evaluation ended.

result.description: Evaluation verdict. 'satisfied': criteria met, session goes idle. 'needs_revision': criteria not met, another revision cycle follows. 'max_iterations_reached': evaluation budget exhausted with criteria still unmet — one final acknowledgment turn follows before the session goes idle, but no further evaluation runs. 'failed': grader determined the rubric does not apply to the deliverables. 'interrupted': user sent an interrupt while evaluation was in progress.

usage.description: Aggregate token usage for this evaluation cycle. Sums across all grader model requests within the cycle.

BetaManagedAgentsSpanModelRequestStartEv.description: Emitted when a model request is initiated by the agent.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when the model request started.

BetaManagedAgentsSpanModelRequestEndEven.description: Emitted when a model request completes.

is_error.description: Whether the model request resulted in an error.

model_request_start_id.description: The id of the corresponding `span.model_request_start` event.

model_usage.description: Token usage for this model request.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when the model request completed.

BetaManagedAgentsSpanOutcomeEvaluationOn.description: Periodic heartbeat emitted while an outcome evaluation cycle is in progress. Distinguishes 'evaluation is actively running' from 'evaluation is stuck' between the corresponding `span.outcome_evaluation_start` and `span.outcome_evaluation_end` events.

outcome_id.description: The `outc_` ID of the outcome being evaluated.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when this heartbeat was emitted.

BetaManagedAgentsUserDefineOutcomeEvent.description: Echo of a `user.define_outcome` input event. Carries the server-generated `outcome_id` that subsequent `span.outcome_evaluation_*` events reference.

rubric.content: Must cover all five sections; cite sources inline.

description.description: What the agent should produce. Copied from the input event.

max_iterations.description: Evaluate-then-revise cycles before giving up. Default 3, max 20.

outcome_id.description: Server-generated `outc_` ID for this outcome. Referenced by `span.outcome_evaluation_*` events and the session's `outcome_evaluations` list.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when the outcome was accepted.

rubric.description: How to grade the outcome. File rubrics are currently resolved to their text content; clients should handle both variants.

examples.content: Must cover all five sections; cite sources inline.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionDeletedEvent.description: Emitted when a session has been deleted. Terminates any active event stream — no further events will be emitted for this session.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when the session was deleted.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStatusRunn.description: A session thread has begun executing. Emitted on the thread's own stream and cross-posted to the primary stream for child threads.

agent_name.description: Name of the agent the thread runs.

processed_at.description: Timestamp of the status transition.

session_thread_id.description: Public sthr_ ID of the thread that started running.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStatusIdle.description: A session thread has yielded and is awaiting input. Emitted on the thread's own stream and cross-posted to the primary stream for child threads.

agent_name.description: Name of the agent the thread runs.

processed_at.description: Timestamp of the status transition.

session_thread_id.description: Public sthr_ ID of the thread that went idle.

stop_details.description: Structured information about why the thread stopped. `null` when there is nothing more to report.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStatusTerm.description: A session thread has terminated and will accept no further input. Emitted on the thread's own stream and cross-posted to the primary stream for child threads.

agent_name.description: Name of the agent the thread runs.

processed_at.description: Timestamp of the status transition.

session_thread_id.description: Public sthr_ ID of the thread that terminated.

BetaManagedAgentsUserToolResultEvent.description: Event sent by the client providing the result of an agent-toolset tool execution. Only valid on `self_hosted` environments, where sandbox-routed tools are executed by the client rather than the server.

content.description: The result content returned by the tool.

is_error.description: Whether the tool execution resulted in an error.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when this result was processed.

session_thread_id.description: Set by the server to the subagent thread this result was routed to. Omitted when it was routed to the primary thread.

tool_use_id.description: The id of the `agent.tool_use` event this result corresponds to, which can be found in the last `session.status_idle` [event's](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/sessions/events/list#beta_managed_agents_session_requires_action.event_ids) `stop_reason.event_ids` field.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStatusResc.description: A session thread hit a transient error and is retrying automatically. Emitted on the thread's own stream and cross-posted to the primary stream for child threads.

agent_name.description: Name of the agent the thread runs.

processed_at.description: Timestamp of the status transition.

session_thread_id.description: Public sthr_ ID of the thread that is retrying.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionUpdatedEvent.description: Emitted when an UpdateSession request changed at least one field. Carries only the fields that changed; absent fields were not part of the update. The new configuration applies from the next turn.

agent.description: The session's effective agent configuration after the update. Present only when the update changed `agent` (tools or mcp_servers); when present it is the full materialised snapshot, not a diff.

budget.description: The session's budget after the update: the new budget when set or replaced, or null when the update removed it. Present only when the update changed the budget.

metadata.description: The session's full metadata bag after the update. Present when the update set non-empty metadata; absent when metadata was unchanged or cleared to empty.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when the update was applied.

title.description: The session's new title. Present only when the update changed it.

BetaManagedAgentsSystemMessageEvent.description: A mid-conversation system message event. Carries system-role content that is appended to the session as a `role: "system"` turn.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when this system message was processed.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionUsageEvent.description: Periodic snapshot of the session's cumulative usage and tracked list cost.

budget.description: The session's configured budget at the snapshot time, or null when the session has no budget.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when the snapshot was taken.

usage.description: The session's cumulative usage at the snapshot time.

BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunCreatedEvent.description: A workflow run was created. A workflow run is background work that the session's agent starts. Emitted once per run, before the run's other `workflow_run.*` events.

example.description: Reads each vendor's pricing page and tabulates the plans.
example.name: Compare the vendors

description.description: Description that the agent gave the run, passed on as written, or `null` if it gave none.
examples: Reads each vendor's pricing page and tabulates the plans.

name.description: Name that the agent gave the run, passed on as written, or a name that the server assigned.

phases.description: The phases that the run's plan declares, in the plan's order. Can be empty.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when this event was processed.

workflow_run_id.description: Identifier of the run. The same value is on all of the run's `workflow_run.*` events.

BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunStatusEndedE.description: A workflow run ended. Emitted once per run, as the last of the run's `workflow_run.*` events.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when this event was processed.

workflow_run_id.description: Identifier of the run. The same value is on all of the run's `workflow_run.*` events.

BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunPhaseStarted.description: A workflow run's plan entered a phase.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when this event was processed.

workflow_run_id.description: Identifier of the run. The same value is on all of the run's `workflow_run.*` events.

workflow_run_phase_id.description: Identifier of the phase, as in `phases` on the run's `workflow_run.created` event.

BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunPhaseEndedEv.description: A workflow run's plan left a phase, or the run's end closed it. Emitted once for every `workflow_run.phase_started` event, before the run's `workflow_run.status_ended` event. The event does not say whether the plan finished the phase's work, or why it left.

phase_started_id.description: Identifier of the `workflow_run.phase_started` event that opened the phase.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when this event was processed.

workflow_run_id.description: Identifier of the run. The same value is on all of the run's `workflow_run.*` events.

workflow_run_phase_id.description: Identifier of the phase, as in `phases` on the run's `workflow_run.created` event.

BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunStatusRunnin.description: A workflow run is running. Emitted when the run starts to execute, and each time it resumes after being idle. A run that starts idle emits `workflow_run.status_idle` first.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when this event was processed.

workflow_run_id.description: Identifier of the run. The same value is on all of the run's `workflow_run.*` events.

BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunStatusIdleEv.description: A workflow run is idle. Emitted each time the run goes idle, whatever the cause. If the run ends while idle, no `workflow_run.status_running` comes between this event and its `workflow_run.status_ended`.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when this event was processed.

workflow_run_id.description: Identifier of the run. The same value is on all of the run's `workflow_run.*` events.

BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunErrorEvent.description: A workflow run met an error, or an error kept a run from being created. A run that ends with a `result.type` of `error` emits this event before its `workflow_run.status_ended`, with the same `error`.

error.description: Why the run did not finish, or was not created.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when this event was processed.

workflow_run_id.description: Identifier of the run that met the error, or `null` when the error kept a run from being created.

BetaManagedAgentsUserContentBlock.description: Content block in a user message. Can be `text`, `image`, or `document`.

BetaManagedAgentsToolResultContentBlock.description: Content block in a tool result. Can be `text`, `image`, `document`, or `search_result`.

BetaManagedAgentsAgentMessageContentBloc.description: Content block in an agent message.

BetaManagedAgentsAgentToolEvaluation.description: Names the resolved permission_policy that produced evaluated_permission, and under auto carries the judgement. Open union: clients must tolerate unknown variants.

BetaManagedAgentsUnknownError.description: An unknown or unexpected error occurred during session execution. A fallback variant; clients that don't recognize a new error code can match on `retry_status` and `message` alone.

retry_status.description: What the client should do next.

BetaManagedAgentsModelOverloadedError.description: The model is currently overloaded. Emitted after automatic retries are exhausted.

retry_status.description: What the client should do next.
What the client should do next.

BetaManagedAgentsModelRequestFailedError.description: A model request failed for a reason other than overload or rate-limiting.

retry_status.description: What the client should do next.

BetaManagedAgentsMcpConnectionFailedErro.description: Failed to connect to an MCP server.

mcp_server_name.description: Name of the MCP server that failed to connect.

retry_status.description: What the client should do next.

BetaManagedAgentsMcpAuthenticationFailed.description: Authentication to an MCP server failed.

mcp_server_name.description: Name of the MCP server that failed authentication.

retry_status.description: What the client should do next.

BetaManagedAgentsBillingError.description: The caller's organization or workspace cannot make model requests — out of credits or spend limit reached. Retrying with the same credentials will not succeed; the caller must resolve the billing state.

retry_status.description: What the client should do next.

BetaManagedAgentsCredentialHostUnreachab.description: An `environment_variable` credential's `auth.networking.allowed_hosts` includes a host the environment's network policy does not permit.

retry_status.description: What the client should do next.

vault_id.description: ID of the vault containing the affected credential.

BetaManagedAgentsToolUseLimitReachedErro.description: The turn stopped because the agent loop reached its limit on tool-use rounds (one model response that calls tools, plus running those tools, is one round), not because a request failed. The thread goes idle with `stop_reason: retries_exhausted` (a child thread then terminates); the next `user.message` starts a new turn.

example.message: This turn stopped because the agent loop reached its limit of 500 tool-use rounds since the turn started or last resumed. A round is one model response that calls tools, plus running those tools. Nothing failed. Send the session a new message to continue; nothing from the stopped turn is discarded.

examples: This turn stopped because the agent loop reached its limit of 500 tool-use rounds since the turn started or last resumed. A round is one model response that calls tools, plus running those tools. Nothing failed. Send the session a new message to continue; nothing from the stopped turn is discarded.

retry_status.description: What the client should do next.

BetaManagedAgentsCompactionLimitReachedE.description: The turn stopped because the context was compacted the maximum number of times in a row without the model producing a message or a tool call, not because a request failed. The thread goes idle with `stop_reason: retries_exhausted` (a child thread then terminates); the next `user.message` starts a new turn.

example.message: This turn stopped because the context was compacted the maximum number of times in a row without the model producing a message or a tool call. Nothing failed. This can happen when content sent with every request, such as a large system prompt, leaves too little room for the conversation. Send the session a new message to continue; nothing from the stopped turn is discarded.

examples: This turn stopped because the context was compacted the maximum number of times in a row without the model producing a message or a tool call. Nothing failed. This can happen when content sent with every request, such as a large system prompt, leaves too little room for the conversation. Send the session a new message to continue; nothing from the stopped turn is discarded.

retry_status.description: What the client should do next.

BetaManagedAgentsRepositoryAuthenticatio.description: The repository host rejected the credentials, or required credentials and received none.

example.message: The repository host rejected the credentials for the repository, or required credentials and received none.

examples: The repository host rejected the credentials for the repository, or required credentials and received none.

repository_url.description: URL of the repository that could not be cloned. Null when it could not be identified.

retry_status.description: What the client should do next. Always `retrying`: the session keeps running without the repository.

BetaManagedAgentsRepositoryForbiddenErro.description: The repository host refused access to the repository.

example.message: The repository host refused access to the repository.

examples: The repository host refused access to the repository.
